# kentik-synthetics_agent_alert (Resource)

Offline alert for a synthetic monitoring agent: notifies the given channels when the agent stops reporting for `threshold_seconds`. Can be imported by alert ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notify two channels when the agent has not reported for 5 minutes.
resource "kentik-synthetics_agent_alert" "office_offline" {
  agent_id                 = "1717"
  threshold_seconds        = 300
  notification_channel_ids = ["1234", "5678"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the agent to watch. Changing it creates a new alert.
- `threshold_seconds` (Number) Alert when the agent has been offline (not reporting) for this many seconds.

### Optional

- `notification_channel_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the notification channels that receive the alert.

### Read-Only

- `agent_name` (String) Name of the agent, as reported by the API.
- `id` (String) ID of the agent alert.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agent alerts are imported by alert ID.
terraform import kentik-synthetics_agent_alert.office_offline 9876
```
